characters.name: Kliff
characters.role: Primary story character and Greymane field leader
characters.summary: The official game description centres the main story on Kliff. Current patch history documents aerial Focus techniques, Force skills, Charge support and expanded unarmed chains.
characters.storyAvailability: The story centres on Kliff; exact unlock timing for later character switching is intentionally not duplicated here.

capabilities.label: Focused Aerial Roll
capabilities.detail: Added in Patch 1.03.00. Official prerequisites are Focus Lv. 3, Flight Lv. 2 and Aerial Roll.

capabilities.label: Force Current
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.04.00 improved ledge safety so Kliff no longer falls when using it.

capabilities.label: Charge
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.04.00 fixed compatibility with certain weapons; exact character-by-weapon coverage is not enumerated by the notice.

capabilities.label: Blinding Flash
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.06.00 allowed Blinding Flash without a weapon equipped.

capabilities.label: Blinding Flash Finisher
capabilities.detail: Added for Kliff's unarmed combat in Patch 1.07.00.

capabilities.label: Expanded equipment access
capabilities.detail: Patches 1.12.00 and 1.13.00 added Kliff headgear, Greymane Light Armor, shared Kliff/Oongka equipment and Kuku equipment access.

currentCautions: PC Hold evasion remapping can still respond to the original key; test controls before a repeatable combat trial.
Character-specific weapon compatibility and hidden scaling must be confirmed in-game rather than inferred from general weapon availability.

patchTimeline.change: Added Focused Aerial Roll with published skill prerequisites.
Improved Force Current ledge safety and fixed Charge with certain weapons.
Improved unarmed combat flow and allowed Blinding Flash without a weapon.
Added Blinding Flash Finisher for unarmed combat.
Added five headgear items and Greymane Light Armor for Kliff.
Expanded Kliff/Oongka equipment and added Kuku equipment compatibility.

characters.name: Oongka
characters.role: Playable specialist with aerial movement, blaster pressure and heavy-weapon support
characters.summary: Oongka is one of the two additional playable characters named by the official game description. Patch history documents Vertical Flight, blaster and Scatter Shot support, Force-equivalent abilities, Ambush, Aerial Stab, Abyss access and expanded equipment compatibility.
characters.storyAvailability: Oongka joins as the story unfolds. Exact spoiler-sensitive unlock timing remains outside the low-spoiler profile.

capabilities.label: Vertical Flight
capabilities.detail: Official patches document Vertical Flight controls, movement fixes and related open-world utility.

capabilities.label: Blaster and Scatter Shot
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.04.00 enabled blaster fire during Flight and corrected Scatter Shot ammunition behaviour.

capabilities.label: Axiom Force and Nature's Snare
capabilities.detail: Added for Oongka and Damiane in Patch 1.03.00.

capabilities.label: Ambush and Focused Force Palm equivalent
capabilities.detail: Added for Oongka and Damiane in Patch 1.04.00.

capabilities.label: Aerial Stab
capabilities.detail: Added for Oongka and Damiane in Patch 1.07.00.

capabilities.label: Blinding Flash Finisher-equivalent skill
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.09.00 added a skill using the same input as Kliff's Blinding Flash Finisher.

capabilities.label: Abyss, Visiones, memories and Blackstar access
capabilities.detail: Patches 1.12.00 and 1.13.00 added Visiones/memory support, Blackstar mounting and Abyss entry.

capabilities.label: Greathammer skill support
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.13.00 corrected Oongka Greathammer skill descriptions, confirming character-specific skill support without establishing performance rankings.

capabilities.label: Expanded equipment and outfit access
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.13.00 added shared Kliff/Oongka equipment, most Kliff outfits for Oongka and Kuku equipment compatibility.

currentCautions: Greymane faction quests may stall as Oongka on Patch 1.15.00; switch to Kliff before continuing the affected objective.
Descriptions corrected in older patches prove intended input text, not exact damage, recovery or stagger values.

patchTimeline.change: Added Axiom Force, Nature's Snare and related open-world abilities; adjusted Vertical Flight input.
Added Ambush and a Focused Force Palm-equivalent skill; improved blaster use during Flight.
Added Aerial Stab.
Added a skill using the same input as Kliff's Blinding Flash Finisher.
Added Visiones, memory reading, Blackstar mounting and chain attacks while sliding.
Added Abyss access, equipment/outfit expansion and corrected Greathammer skill descriptions.
Fixed persistence of equipped-gear lock status for Oongka and Damiane.

characters.name: Damiane
characters.role: Playable specialist with shield control, ranged support and mobility tools
characters.summary: Damiane is one of the two additional playable characters named by the official game description. Patch history documents Shield Toss, Skystep, Quick Reload, unarmed skills, Force-equivalent abilities, Abyss access and character-specific equipment expansion.
characters.storyAvailability: Damiane joins as the story unfolds. Exact spoiler-sensitive unlock timing remains outside the low-spoiler profile.

capabilities.label: Shield Toss and shield control
capabilities.detail: Official patches document Shield Toss's Force Palm-equivalent effect and the current death-state known issue.

capabilities.label: Skystep mobility
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.03.00 changed Skystep's control input as part of open-world capability improvements.

capabilities.label: Axiom Force and Nature's Snare
capabilities.detail: Added for Damiane and Oongka in Patch 1.03.00.

capabilities.label: Ambush and Focused Force Palm equivalent
capabilities.detail: Added for Damiane and Oongka in Patch 1.04.00.

capabilities.label: Quick Reload
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.04.00 made Quick Reload obtainable through skill observation or Abyss Artifacts.

capabilities.label: Unarmed combat skills
capabilities.detail: Added under Fists in the skill menu in Patch 1.07.00.

capabilities.label: Aerial Stab
capabilities.detail: Added for Damiane and Oongka in Patch 1.07.00.

capabilities.label: Blinding Flash Finisher-equivalent skill
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.09.00 added a skill using the same input as Kliff's Blinding Flash Finisher.

capabilities.label: Abyss, Visiones, memories and Blackstar access
capabilities.detail: Patches 1.12.00 and 1.13.00 added Visiones/memory support, Blackstar mounting and Abyss entry.

capabilities.label: Expanded armor and boss-equipment access
capabilities.detail: Patch 1.13.00 added eight armor pieces and specified supported boss-equipment sets.

currentCautions: Greymane faction quests may stall as Damiane on Patch 1.15.00; switch to Kliff before continuing the affected objective.
Dying immediately after Shield Toss can disable shield actions; save and reload before another fight.
Quick Reload acquisition options prove availability, not a universal ranged-build advantage.

patchTimeline.change: Added Axiom Force, Nature's Snare and related abilities; adjusted Skystep input and Shield Toss utility.
Added Ambush and a Focused Force Palm-equivalent skill; expanded Quick Reload acquisition.
Added unarmed combat skills and Aerial Stab.
Added a skill using the same input as Kliff's Blinding Flash Finisher.
Added Visiones, memory reading, Blackstar mounting and chain attacks while sliding.
Added Abyss access and expanded armor and boss-equipment compatibility.
Fixed persistence of equipped-gear lock status for Oongka and Damiane.
